mapper.select: SELECT id,owner_member_id AS ownerMemberId,business_type AS businessType,status,version,payload_hash AS payloadHash FROM content_draft WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_member_id=#{buyer} FOR UPDATE

SELECT draft_id AS id,owner_member_id AS ownerMemberId,draft_version AS version,payload_hash AS payloadHash,region FROM w18_content_draft_install_scope WHERE draft_id=#{id} AND draft_version=#{version} FOR UPDATE

SELECT DISTINCT s.scope_id FROM w18_module_install_scope s JOIN w18_module_install_reservation r ON r.reservation_key=s.reservation_key JOIN w18_module_install_usage u ON u.reservation_key=r.reservation_key WHERE r.license_id=#{claimId} AND r.buyer_kind='INDIVIDUAL' AND r.buyer_id=#{buyer} AND r.state='CONSUMED' AND s.scope_kind='THEME' ORDER BY s.scope_id
